import MySQLdb

def buy_stock(db, stock_name, stock_quantity, username):

    cur.execute("INSERT INTO stock_orders(stock_name, stock_quantity, username) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)", (stock_name, stock_quantity, username))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
